verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an AI assistant (New Relic AI), so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence only documents New Relic's own official MCP server, which lets external AI tools connect into New Relic. That is the server role. Nothing shows New Relic AI or any other part of the product connecting to or consuming tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
